{{Quote|Mesa luven! Is berry berry good tongue-grabben. Yousa find only in one placen... In the mud under the perlote tree!|[[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]], describing slug-beetles|<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus (episode)">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>}}
'''Slug-beetles''' were bright blue, winged [[Insect/Legends|insects]] found in the roots of the [[Perlote tree/Legends|perlote tree]] found only in the [[Eastern swamps/Legends|eastern swamps]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. They were a favorite delicacy of [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]. They could also be found on the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
